name: Outlier Detect
description: Flags rows with an added Boolean 'outlier' column: IQR fences (q1 - k*iqr, q3 + k*iqr) or z-score bounds (mean +- k*stddev) per numeric column, or a distance-based model on the selected columns - DBSCAN noise, a local outlier factor above the (1 - contamination) quantile, or the top contamination fraction of an isolation-forest anomaly score. The distance-based methods standardize the features first and also add a Float64 'score' (k-th-neighbour distance, LOF value or normalized anomaly score).

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns checked for outliers; a row is flagged when any of them is outside its range (iqr, zscore) or when the row is an outlier in the selected feature space (dbscan, lof, isolation_forest).

method.title: Method
method.description: iqr uses quartile fences, zscore the distance from the mean in standard deviations, dbscan flags noise points, lof the local outlier factor and isolation_forest the anomaly score of an isolation forest.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Multiplier for the fence width: the IQR multiplier (default 1.5) or the z-score limit (default 3). Used by iqr and zscore only.

eps.title: DBSCAN radius
eps.description: Neighbourhood radius in the standardized feature space; positive. Used by dbscan only.

min_points.title: DBSCAN minimum points
min_points.description: Minimum neighbourhood size (including the point itself) for a core point; positive. Used by dbscan only.

k.title: Neighbours
k.description: Number of neighbours for the DBSCAN k-th-neighbour score and for the LOF density; positive. Clamped to rows - 1.

contamination.title: Contamination
contamination.description: Expected fraction of outliers in [0, 0.5]; lof and isolation_forest flag scores above the (1 - contamination) quantile, so 0 disables flagging.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Seed of the isolation-forest sampling; the same seed and input give the same scores.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows
max_rows.description: Distance-based methods are computed in memory and support at most this many rows; a larger input is an error with a hint to raise the cap or pre-filter.
